Resume after TV restart
Runs on your TV · No root · Free and open source

First use
1. Pair the remote with the TV over Bluetooth.
2. Keep TV network ADB debugging enabled on port 5555, then select Start.
3. In the TV debugging prompt, select Always allow and Allow.

Daily use
You can close this screen; repair keeps running. Enable Resume after TV restart for automatic startup. Stop saves the stopped state, including after restart.

If disconnected
Press a remote button to wake it. The app retries automatically. If it still cannot connect, check TV ADB debugging and authorization.

Remove
Uninstall Sony Keyfix in TV settings. Do not run another remapping script at the same time.

An independent project for Sony X9500H and RMF-TX910C. Not affiliated with Sony.

Repairs four Bluetooth buttons using authorized ADB on this TV. No cloud service, ads, analytics or accessibility service. Voice stays on the normal system path.

Your TV must allow local ADB shell access. Keep network debugging on a trusted home network.
